ticker.name: Western Asset High Income Opportunity Fund Inc.

business_summary: Western Asset High Income Opportunity Fund Inc. is a closed ended fixed-income mutual fund launched and managed by Legg Mason Partners Fund Advisor, LLC. It is co-managed by Western Asset Management Company and Western Asset Management Company Limited. The fund invests in the fixed income markets of the United States. It seeks to invest in high-yielding corporate debt obligations. The fund seeks to maintain an average duration of around four years with an average credit quality of B. It benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the Barclays Capital U.S. Corporate High Yield 2% Issuer Cap Index. The fund was formerly known as High Income Opportunity Fund. Western Asset High Income Opportunity Fund Inc. was formed on November 16, 1993 and is domiciled in the United States.
business_summary_ko: Western Asset High Income Opportunity Fund Inc.는 Legg Mason Partners Fund Advisor, LLC가 시작하고 관리하는 폐쇄형 고정 수입 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. Western Asset Management Company와 Western Asset Management Company Limited가 공동 관리합니다. 이 펀드는 미국 채권 시장에 투자합니다. 고수익 기업 부채에 투자하려고 합니다. 이 펀드는 평균 신용도 B로 약 4년의 평균 듀레이션을 유지하려고 합니다. Barclays Capital U.S. Corporate High Yield 2% Issuer Cap Index를 기준으로 포트폴리오 성과를 벤치마킹합니다. 이 기금은 이전에는 고소득 기회 기금(High Income Opportunity Fund)으로 알려졌습니다. Western Asset High Income Opportunity Fund Inc.는 1993년 11월 16일에 설립되었으며 미국에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
